PART III – LANDS
Land Redemption Notices
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Rൾඏඈർൺඍංඈඇ ඎඇൽൾඋ Sൾർඍංඈඇ 39 (1)

THE allotments of land speciﬁ ed morefully in the Order No. 308 dated 31.10.2014 made under the Proviso (a) to Section 38 of the Land Acquisition Act and published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 1887/41 dated 07.11.2014 was vested in the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka. The possession of the land depicted below has not yet been taken for and on behalf of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka. Therefore, I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation, by virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 39(1) of the Land Acquisition Act, do hereby revoke the Order made in respect of the land speciﬁ ed in the Schedule of the Order No. 308 of 2014 dated 31.10.2014 published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 1887/41 dated 07.11.2014. K.D. Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation.
